blocks.text: Remember when growing up meant getting the things you wanted, going to places you once dreamed of, and figuring life out alongside the people closest to you? Everything seemed possible. There was a time when adulthood felt less like something to fear and more like an adventure waiting to unfold. You didn’t have to know exactly where life would take you or have everything figured out just yet.
